request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-004: Reject transaction that originated after the account expiration date (overrides overlimit reason)

### given[0]: The account record was found. The credit-limit check has already run, and it may have set reason 102.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'WS-TEMP-BAL', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['102']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON

### when[0]: The account expiration date (10 characters) is less than the first 10 characters (the date part) of the transaction's origination timestamp. This is a text comparison, not a date comparison, and an expiration date equal to the transaction date passes.
fields=['ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE', 'DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   424        2000-POST-TRANSACTION.

### then[0]: The failure reason code is set to 103 and the failure description to 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'. This replaces any reason 102 and its description set by the credit-limit check.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['103', 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

### then[1]: Because the failure reason is not 0, the transaction is not posted. Instead the reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['0', '1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220 

### then[2]: The reject record holds the original daily transaction record followed by the validation trailer, which carries the reason code (103) and its description.
fields=['DALYTRAN-RECORD', 'REJECT-TRAN-DATA', 'WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER', 'VALIDATION-TRAILER', 'REJECT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   443 
   444            EXIT.
   445 
   446        2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC.
>> 447            MOVE DALYTRAN-RECORD TO REJECT-TRAN-DATA
>> 448            MOVE WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER TO VALIDATION-TRAILER
>> 449       *     DISPLAY '***' REJECT-RECORD
>> 450            MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 451            WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD FROM REJECT-RECORD
   452            IF DALYREJS-STATUS = '00'
   453                MOVE 0 TO  APPL-RESULT
   454            ELSE
   455                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 403-413 show the credit-limit check computing WS-TEMP-BAL and setting reason 102 when the limit is exceeded, just before the expiration check."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 414 compares ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS(1:10), an alphanumeric comparison against a reference-modified substring, so equality passes and lesser fails."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 417-419 move 103 and the stated description into the reason fields; because this runs after the credit-limit check, it overwrites any 102."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-216 post only when WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0; otherwise they add 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and perform 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":false,"reason":"Lines 447-451 only move DALYTRAN-RECORD and WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER into reject fields and write REJECT-RECORD; that the trailer follows the data and holds the reason code and description depends on data definitions that are not cited."}]}
